comparability_requirements: same period, currency, entity, statement, and attribution basis
sector semantic class verified before operating/non-operating label
no double count across subtotal and components
design.currency_basis: same verified financial currency; no inferred FX conversion
design.daily_delta_use: only newly effective post-baseline validated change; preserve M3 cutoff lineage
directional_core_usage: limit an operating-quality conclusion when material verified effects explain NI
keep financial-sector core revenue semantics separate
design.entity_attribution_basis: same issuer, consolidation scope, statement basis, and attribution basis
forbidden_derivations: pretax income minus operating income called complete non-operating income
tax effect attributed without direct evidence
net-income improvement equated with operating improvement
design.initial_analysis_use: eligible as absolute evidence when valid and material
message_usage: name the reported effect and period
do not use a generic non-operating label where sector treatment differs
design.missing_data_behavior: No attribution claim; missing evidence is not negative
design.monitoring_baseline_use: may enrich baseline; enrichment is not Daily Delta
non_applicable_or_caution_sector_familie: financial institution where interest is core economics
period_basis: same income-statement duration and fiscal period

failure_conditions: incomplete bridge or sector semantic mismatch
safe_derivations.formula: signed sum of complete, non-overlapping mapped components
safe_derivations.name: verified_non_operating_component_sum

design.single_quarter_vs_cumulative_semantics: QTD, YTD, FY, TTM, and point-in-time remain distinct; no label-based guess
design.valuation_usage: context for denominator quality only; no multiple, price target, or valuation fact
design.warning_kill_condition_use: may support warning when material and contextual; no one-period automatic kill
